source: Direct learning conversation with the learner
lessonTheme: State a goal and explain a reason; apply it to software work
summary: Practised quiero + infinitive and porque + reason. One complete prompted sentence was correct. A self-created work sentence revealed queremos as the next correction target. Discussed probar for software testing versus trying something out.

observations.outcome: Correction explained; independent retry not observed.

observations.description: The learner used ser for a person's location.
observations.outcome: Estar for location was explained; independent retry not observed.
Correct quiero + infinitive structure. The ñ spelling was supplied.

observations.description: Combined a goal with a reason; wrote poque and espanol.
observations.outcome: Sentence structure correct; porque and español spelling corrected. Other details omitted as unnecessary personal context.

observations.learnerText: Quiero revisar esto porque esto ne es correcto
observations.correctedText: Quiero revisar esto porque no es correcto.
observations.outcome: Goal and reason successfully combined. No before es was explained; independent negative statement still pending.

observations.learnerText: quiero revisar esto porque es importante
observations.correctedText: Quiero revisar esto porque es importante.
observations.outcome: Correct full sentence after vocabulary hints in the preceding tutor turn; no full-sentence model was shown in that immediate prompt. This is successful use, not a delayed retention test.

observations.learnerText: quiero testar las achievments porque quieremos deploy them
observations.correctedText: Quiero probar los logros porque queremos publicarlos.
observations.outcome: Applied goal-and-reason structure to own work. Tutor supplied software vocabulary and corrected quieremos to queremos. Testar was replaced with a natural alternative, not established as an invalid Spanish word.

observations.description: Asked whether probar means testing software rather than trying something out.
observations.outcome: Explained that probar covers both; introduced hacer pruebas and ejecutar las pruebas. No independent production of these expressions yet.

nextSteps: Practise no before a conjugated verb
Use probar in a software-testing sentence
Revisit quiero ... porque ... after a gap
assessmentNote: No formal proficiency assessment or measured retention test has been completed.
